module_digests.form: sha256 over the raw working-tree bytes, PLUS a second sha256 over the LF-normalised form of the same bytes. Both are recorded so a reader can compare against an LF manifest whichever form their checkout produced. The flag below is MEASURED from the bytes rather than asserted, so a CRLF checkout flips it to false without anything being edited -- which is why it describes the checkout and not the delivered file, and why no check may require it to be true. `.gitattributes` pins these paths to LF so the committed blobs and their digests reproduce on any checkout.
